If you have some time to work with, try this one out. Chop up some onion, bell pepper, and tomato and throw it in a pan with some spices (whatever you like, it's really about flavor). Next, take two eggs and cook them however you love your eggs cooked - I cook the eggs in the same pan as the veggies, scrambling them together. If you don't like eggs, let me know and I'll offer a good substitute. While the eggs are cooking, grab a slice of bread and throw it on a pan with a little butter/oil and some seasoning (black pepper, paprika, garlic powder, and a dash of salt work well in a pinch). Cook the bread until its reached the toasty-ness you prefer, and put it on a plate to cool. If you enjoy hummus, spread some on the toast, then place the eggs and veggies on top. Top it with sliced avocado and enjoy.

Also, if you don't like either of these, I would recommend a smoothie made with strawberries, cherries, lemon, and cayenne pepper. Cayenne is great in the morning because it dilates your blood vessels and increases your alertness.
